name: KPI Green Energy Ltd
tagline: Renewable-energy IPP/EPC near a 52-week low after a real FY26 growth print (+56% revenue/PAT) gave way to a Q1 FY27 profit miss (-14% PAT YoY) on debt-funded-capex finance costs, with a 44.7%-pledged promoter stake as the fresh governance overhang
business_overview: KPI Green Energy develops and operates renewable energy (solar/wind) projects, both as an independent power producer (IPP) and EPC contractor. As of Mar 2026 it had ~1.62 GW installed plus ~4.64 GW under execution (~4.74 GW cumulative at the company level: 2.17 GW IPP + 2.57 GW CPP; the wider KP Group portfolio is ~8.52 GW), a 3.61 GW order book, and a stated target of 10 GW by 2030.
fundamentals_table: 18% (FY24) -> 14% (FY25) -> ~13.8% (FY26) - declining trend as fresh capex lands ahead of revenue ramp
~1.5-1.7x - consolidated borrowings roughly quadrupled in FY26 (Rs1,475cr FY25 -> ~Rs4,530-5,200cr FY26) to fund the capacity build-out
40-50% revenue CAGR through FY30 / 10 GW capacity by 2030 (vs ~4.74-8.52 GW installed+pipeline today)
Rs 272 - 541.9 (near the low, down ~48% from peak)
~44.7% of the ~49% promoter stake pledged; lender (SBI) sanction states pledge to be released by March 2027 on project completion
fundamentals_narrative: FY26 was a genuine record year (consolidated revenue +56.2% YoY to Rs2,741.52cr, PAT +56.55% YoY to Rs509.24cr, EBITDA margin ~36-37%), but Q1 FY27 broke the trend: revenue growth decelerated sharply to +15-16% YoY and PAT fell 14% YoY (to ~Rs95cr) even though EBITDA margin held/expanded slightly YoY (~35-37%) - the PAT miss is attributable to sharply higher depreciation and finance costs from FY26's debt-funded capacity build (consolidated borrowings roughly quadrupled to ~Rs4,500-5,200cr), not clear operating-margin erosion, though management also cited 'geopolitical' input-cost pressure (steel, cables, module-mounting structures, logistics) industry-wide. ROCE has declined for two straight years (18% FY24 -> 14% FY25 -> ~13.8% FY26) as fresh capex lands ahead of the revenue ramp, and free cash flow remains deeply negative on the capex programme. A new, material governance/leverage data point this pass: ~44.7% of the promoter's ~49% stake is pledged (lender SBI has sanctioned release by March 2027 on project completion) alongside a routine-looking statutory-auditor rotation (MSKC & Associates LLP appointed for a fresh 5-year term at the 18th AGM) and a CFO transition (Salim Yahoo out, Kapil Kriplani in) - none individually a disqualifying red flag, but together they add real near-term execution and monitoring risk on top of the already-elevated leverage.
technical_read: Stock near its 52-week low (~Rs284 vs a Rs541.9 high), down ~48% from peak - not checked for a trend/EMA read this pass.
sentiment_summary: Read most recent 50 of 317 posts (single batch, no escalation). Only 2 posts in the fetched window are from the current period (Aug 2026), both raising the same open question: is the recent margin pressure temporary or structural.

bull_case: FY26 delivered a real, large growth print: consolidated revenue +56.2% YoY (Rs2,741.52cr), PAT +56.55% YoY (Rs509.24cr), EBITDA margin ~36-37% - not just a management target, an achieved result
3.61 GW order book plus ~4.64 GW under execution (on top of ~1.62 GW installed) gives multi-year revenue visibility against the stated 10 GW-by-2030 target

Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin actually held/expanded slightly YoY (~35-37%) - the PAT decline traces to depreciation/finance costs from the capex ramp, not clear operating-margin erosion, which argues for 'timing' over 'structural' on the community's open question

verdict_headline: FY26's real 56% growth print is now shadowed by a Q1 FY27 profit miss, a freshly-confirmed 44.7% promoter pledge, and two years of declining ROCE -- the order book keeps this in the 10x bucket, but conviction stays capped at Low-Medium
verdict_reasoning: four_box = 3.0 (tailwind yes - national renewable buildout + 10GW-by-2030 target with a real 3.61 GW order book; tam yes - large addressable capacity growth against a ~Rs5,526cr market cap; moat weak - commodity solar/wind IPP-EPC model, no pricing-power or switching-cost edge found; valuation weak - ~12x trailing P/E after a ~48% correction looks statistically cheap but is compensation for real, now-confirmed leverage/governance risk, not a clean mispricing). Score 3.0 keeps 10x-in-2-3-years permitted.

This pass converts the pre-dive's vague 'margin pressure' concern into harder, more specific findings: consolidated borrowings roughly quadrupled in FY26 to fund the capacity build (D/E now ~1.5-1.7x), ROCE has declined for two straight years (18%->14%->~13.8%), Q1 FY27 PAT fell 14% YoY even as EBITDA margin held/expanded YoY (pointing to a finance-cost/depreciation timing issue more than structural margin erosion), and free cash flow remains deeply negative on the capex programme

New and material: ~44.7% of the promoter's ~49% stake is pledged - not disclosed in the pre-dive file. A lender (SBI) sanction states the pledge will be released by March 2027 on project completion, which tempers but does not eliminate the concern; a concurrent CFO transition and a statutory-auditor rotation (Aug 2026, appears to be a routine 5-year term appointment rather than a resignation-under-a-cloud) add near-term monitoring noise on top

No AVOID/EXCLUDE-tier red flag found (no going-concern signal, no SEBI/fraud order, promoter holding not collapsing, pledge has a stated release timeline) - HIGH CAUTION not set, but the pledge + leverage + declining ROCE + latest-quarter PAT miss together keep this well short of an upgrade

Conviction held at Low-Medium (unchanged from pre-dive) - the growth/order-book story is real and intact, but this pass hardens rather than resolves the risk side of the ledger; net effect is confirmatory, pending 1-2 more quarters of clarity on whether PAT reconnects with revenue/EBITDA growth

four_box.note: 3.61 GW order book + ~4.64 GW under execution + management's 10GW-by-2030 target is a real renewable-IPP tailwind and tam against a ~Rs5,526cr market cap; no distinct moat for a commodity solar/wind IPP-EPC model — weak; stock near a 52-wk low after a ~48% correction but the ~12x P/E is compensation for now-confirmed leverage risk (D/E ~1.5-1.7x, borrowings ~4x'd in FY26) and a 44.7%-pledged promoter stake, not a clean mispricing — valuation weak.
